data: dense dumps of the 56 training pairs of blend/probe/pairs.json (32 forza 30->60, 8 cs2, 8 minecraft120, 8 battlefield 60->120); scored on the 23 held-out pairs
loss: Charbonnier mean(sqrt((out - real)^2 + 1e-6)) + lam * mean(relu(G(out) - G(real))); colours 0..1, G = Sobel magnitude of luma (0.299 R + 0.587 G + 0.114 B) on the crop interior, sqrt(gx^2 + gy^2 + 1e-8) while training; output = sum of weights x candidates
lam_start_share: about 46 % of the start loss (start terms: Charbonnier 0.014705, penalty 0.012512)
choice_rule: strongest lam with all-pairs whole PSNR at most 0.10 dB and every group at most 0.25 dB below forza-rx9070xt C
